item.title: Sherlock Holmes: Why Prewarming a Voice Agent Didn't Make the First Reply Faster
item.description: This one did not start as a latency mystery. It started as a bill. We prewarm a voice agent before the call connects. You send the model a request early, and you open the speech sockets early, so that if a person picks up, the first reply is already on its way.

item.title: PostgreSQL Internals and Operations
item.description: Second part of PostgreSQL. That note = using Postgres. This note = how it stores data on disk and how to run it in production. 1. Storage: pages & tuples Postgres stores all its data in a directory sensibly called /var/lib/postgresql/data DirectoryExplanationbase/One subdirectory per database, holding the actual table and index filesglobal/Cluster-wide tables like pg_databasepg_wal/Write-Ahead Log files (section 2)pg_xact/Commit status of every transaction (committed / aborted)pg_multixact/Multitransactions → when several sessions row-lock the same rowpg_subtrans/Subtransactions (savepoints)pg_commit_ts/Commit timestamps (if enabled)pg_replslot/Replication slots → keep WAL around for a replica (section 7)pg_logical/Logical decoding status (turning WAL back into row changes)pg_snapshots/Exported snapshots, e.g.
